simple.meaning: to spread out (i.e. deploy in hostile array); by analogy, to strip (i.e. unclothe, plunder, flay, etc.)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to פָּשַׁט (H6584) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 43 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: פָּשַׁט (pâshaṭ) means to spread out (i.e. deploy in hostile array); by analogy, to strip (i.e. unclothe, plunder, flay, etc.) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 10 8.

definitions.full: H6584. pashat מָּשַׁט verb strip off, make a dash, raid (compare Assyrian pašât‰u , expunge, obliterate ; Late Hebrew מָּשַׁט Aramaic מְּשַׁט , , are stretch out, extend, make plain , so Arabic ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular ׳פ Hosea 7:1 +, 2 masculine singular וּפָשַׁטְדָמתּ֫ Judg 9:33 , etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular וַיִפְשַׁט 1Sam 19:24 ; 3 masculine plural יִפְשֹׁ֑טוּ Ezek 26:1 , etc.; Imperative masculine singular מְּשֹׁ֫טָה Isa 32:11 ; Participle plural מּשְׁטִים Neh 4:17 ; — 1 strip off, put off , one's garment (accusative) 1Sam 19:24 ; Ezek 26:16 ; Lev 6:4 (opposed to לָבַשׁ ), 16:23 ( id. ; both P), Neh 4:17 ; Song 5:3 ; accusative omitted Isa 32:11 ; of locusts Nahum 3:16 stripping off (sheaths of wings, compare Da Dr Amos.85). 2 put off (one's shelter), i.e. make a dash (from a sheltered place), with אֶל Judg 20:37 , absolute 9:44 ; especially of marauding foray Hosea 7:1 , c עַל against Judg 9:33 , 44 ; 1Sam 23:27 ; 30:14 (insert עַל compare ᵐ5 We Dr al), Job 1:17 c אֶל 1Sam 27:8 ; 30:1 , with בְּ 1Chr 14:9 , 13 ; 2Chr 25:13 ; 28:18 ; in 1Sam 27:10 read אָן (for אַלֿ ) We Dr and others Pi`el infinitive construct לְפַשֵּׁט , with accusative of person 1Sam 31:8 to strip the slain = 1Chr 10:8 ; absolute only to strip (that is, the slain) 2Sam 23:10 (insert also || 1Chr 11:13 Dr). Hiph`il Perfect 3masculine singular הִפְשִׁיט Job 19:9 ; 3 masculine plural suffix וְהִפְשִׁיטוךְ Ezek 23:26 etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular וַיַּפְשֵׁט Num 20:28 ; 1 singular suffix אַפְשִׁיטֶנָּה Hosea 2:5 ; 2 masculine plural תַּפְשִׁט֑וּן Micah 2:8 , etc.; Imperative הַפְשֵׁט Num 20:26 ; Infinitive construct הַפְשִׁיט 2Chr 29:34 ; Participle plural מַפְשִׁיטִים 35:11 ; — 1 strip one of garment (2 accusative) Gen 37:23 (E), Num 20:26 , 28 (opposed to הִלְבִּישׁ >), Ezek 16:39 ; 23:26 ; a. accusative of person alone 1Chr 10:9 ; Hosea 2:5 strip her (suffix) naked ( עֲרֻמָּה ). 2 strip off , accusative כֵּלָיו 1Sam 31:9 , clothing Job 22:6 ; with accusative אֶדֶר + מִטּוּל Micah 2:8 ; with accusative עוֺר + מֵעַל 3:3 , compare (accusative כְּבוֺדִי ) Job 19:9 . 3 flay , with accusative הָעֹלָה Lev 1:6 ; 2Chr 29:4 ; accusative omitted 35:11 . Hithpa`el Imperfect 3masculine singular וַיִּתְמַּשֵּׁט 1Sam 18:4 he stripped himself of his garment (accusative).
